rules_text.english: High temperatures in the Tropiclands make daytime work tough. Lack of Cooling will reduce a villager's movement speed. Satisfying this need activates the {UI.Boost.Refreshment.WithIcon}, making it easier to satisfy every other need.

The high temperatures of the <style=Input>Tropiclands</style> make villagers walk much slower. 
They now have a new need: <style=Input>{Concern.Refreshment.WithIcon}</style>.

<style=Input>{Building.TropicalHouse.WithIconPlural}</style> are made of <style=Input>{Resource.Reed.WithIconPlural}</style>, a <style=Input>{ResourceCategory.Construction.WithIcon}</style> found exclusively in the <style=Input>Tropiclands</style>.
